hook_verbatim: Hi everyone. It's Justine. There are style rules virtually all French women agree on, and there are also things they would never do in terms of outfits. Since I work in fashion and I'm French, I get asked about French style a lot. So I discussed this topic with some well-dressed French friends, and we put a list together of things they would never do and what they would do instead. Here comes the list of 10 tips for French chic. [0:26]
promise: The speaker promises to share 10 essential style rules that French women follow to maintain effortless French chic.

points.name: Do not mix black and brown
points.exact_words: If you are a French woman, you will usually not mix black and brown in the same outfit, it's either or. That's why you own black boots and brown boots, black heels and brown heels, black sandals and brown sandals.
points.why_given: French women consider mixing black and brown a clash, preferring to stick to either an all-black or all-brown footwear/accessory scheme.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '1', host speaking directly to camera.

points.name: No more than two colors at the same time
points.exact_words: You will probably not wear more than two colors at the same time in an outfit. Exception: blue jeans, that would be a third color, but that's it.
points.why_given: Wearing more than two colors or mixing multiple prints makes an outfit look overly loud and busy.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '2', host speaking directly to camera.

points.name: No all-jogging outfits
points.exact_words: No all jogging outfits, ever actually.
points.why_given: Full sweatpant outfits convey a lack of effort and sartorial discipline, referenced via Karl Lagerfeld's famous quote.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '3', host to camera, text quote by Karl Lagerfeld on black screen.

points.name: No over-accessorizing
points.exact_words: No over-accessorizing. If you're wearing large earrings, you probably won't wear a necklace on top. Less is more, less is effortless, and effortless is great.
points.why_given: Over-accessorizing ruins the effortless aesthetic; keeping jewelry simple and sticking to one metal type creates a clean look.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '4', host speaking to camera gesturing to her earrings and silver rings.

points.name: Stick to your personal style and invest in key pieces
points.exact_words: If you are a French woman, you will not change style every season or every year. You know what fits you in terms of cuts, length, colors, etc., and you'll actually just stick to it.
points.why_given: Investing disposable income into timeless, high-quality key pieces creates a durable wardrobe over chasing short-lived fashion trends.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '5', host speaking directly to camera.

points.name: Your purse should match your shoes
points.exact_words: Your purse should match your shoes, which means a huge closet! Exception though: cocktail outfits and evening gowns, in which case the shoes will have to match the dress and not the purse.
points.why_given: Matching shoes and handbag creates visual harmony, except for formal wear where shoes match the gown.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '6', host speaking to camera, text quote by Gabrielle Chanel on black screen.

points.name: Rely on neutral base colors and use one accent color
points.exact_words: French women tend to rely heavily on neutral colors taken in a quite broad sense... And then there will be one accent color coming in to break the monotony.
points.why_given: Neutrals create an easy foundation, while a single pop of color or statement accessory breaks visual monotony without overwhelming the look.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '7', host speaking to camera gesturing to neck, head, ears, and wrist.

points.name: Stick to classic red lips and red nails
points.exact_words: French women have always and will always wear red lips and red nails... You will not see green, yellow, black, white, orangeish or anything like that.
points.why_given: Gimmicky or unnatural makeup colors lack classic elegance; classic red shades remain timeless.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '8', host speaking to camera pointing to her red lipstick and nails.

points.name: Match sock color to shoe tone
points.exact_words: If you wear dark or black shoes, you'll wear black socks. If you're wearing white or clear shoes, you'll wear white socks, that's it.
points.why_given: Matching sock tone to shoe tone maintains a clean, seamless leg line without distracting color breaks.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '9', host speaking directly to camera.

points.name: Ensure proper fit and cut
points.exact_words: French women are truly good at knowing how a proper fit should look like. They will wear clothes that have their size, a proper cut: not too tight on the belly, not too loose on the bum, not too short if it's a top...
points.why_given: Properly fitted clothing flatters the body shape and prevents awkward exposure when moving or raising arms.
points.how_shown: Cyan title card '10', host speaking to camera raising her arms to demonstrate top length.
